pages.title: drawgen: quotes built on data, not memory
pages.description: drawgen connects the systems your data already lives in, so every quote is faster to send and priced on what similar jobs actually cost.

pages.title: Product: four products on one record | drawgen
pages.description: BOM, Drawings, Costing and Sourcing, all built on the drawgen record: one record per part, joined on its shape across every system you run.

pages.title: The drawgen record: one record per part
pages.description: One record per part, joined on the part's shape rather than its number, so it works even when part numbers are a mess. Your CAD files stay on your machine.

pages.title: BOM: every part measured, in one BOM | drawgen
pages.description: Material, size, mass, surface area and quantity for every part, plus what to make and what to buy. Your engineer reviews it before it goes anywhere.

pages.title: Drawings: derived from the solid | drawgen
pages.description: One dimensioned sheet per part, editable, in your own drawing format. Anything it cannot determine is flagged, and your engineer finishes it.

pages.title: Costing: quotes that match actual cost | drawgen
pages.description: Every price built on something that actually happened: a price you paid, a job you finished, a part you already built.

pages.title: Sourcing: buy on what you have paid | drawgen
pages.description: See which supplier has been cheapest and fastest for each kind of part, and send every RFQ as one complete package.

pages.title: Special-purpose machinery | drawgen
pages.description: Every machine is a one-off. The quote should not be a guess. Weeks to get a quote out, and the knowledge sits with one or two people close to retirement.

pages.title: Material handling and conveyors | drawgen
pages.description: Frames, supports and guarding redrawn and re-measured on every job, even when half of it matches the last one.

pages.title: Packaging machinery | drawgen
pages.description: Machined parts and pneumatics bought from whoever was used last time, with no view of who is actually cheaper.

pages.title: Automation and robotic cells | drawgen
pages.description: Robots, pneumatics and sensors bought in, fixtures and frames made to drawing, all in one BOM that has to be split by hand.

pages.title: Heavy fabrication and steel | drawgen
pages.description: Big steel, measured off the model, not with a tape. Cut lengths and coating areas measured by hand off the model, and critical edge-to-hole dimensions missed.

pages.title: Lifting equipment | drawgen
pages.description: Quoted with the engineering in it, not discovered after. Load ratings, certified welding and proof testing costed after the quote went out.

pages.title: Talk to us: show us one of your jobs | drawgen
pages.description: Show us one of your jobs. The fastest way to see whether drawgen works for you is to try it on something real.
